commentary.text: 90+4' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' What a poor attempt! Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.

86' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the left post and ricochet away.
85' Michel Adopo (Atalanta) jumps into a tackle and Antonio Rapuano signals a foul. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Ylber Ramadani.
82' Aleksey Miranchuk bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
82' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
81' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
81' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Antonio Rapuano signals a set piece. A free kick to Atalanta.
79' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) but poses no threat.

78' Isak Hien (Atalanta) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
78' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.

78' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
75' Giovanni Bonfanti will be replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
74' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
73' Remi Oudin (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
72' A pass by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
71' Total attempts – 9:16. The current number of shots on goal is 2:8.
68' Substitution. Mario Pasalic will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Atalanta).

67' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Remi Oudin (Lecce) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
67' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
65' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rafael Toloi (Atalanta).
62' The game has come to an end for Gianluca Scamacca. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
62' The resulting corner from Remi Oudin (Lecce) comes to nothing.

61' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) squanders a huge chance from point blank range. His volley is directed towards the right side of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert and makes an amazing save!
57' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) meets a cross from Remi Oudin, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
56' A dangerous towering header by Isak Hien (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
56' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' Here comes a substitution. Joan Gonzalez is given a rest as he is replaced by Remi Oudin (Lecce).
54' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Patrick Dorgu as he is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
54' Luca Gotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexis Blin (Lecce) replacing Medon Berisha.
54' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Antonio Rapuano to decide it wasn’t a foul. The relieved Atalanta players can finally celebrate.
54' The Atalanta players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

53' 0 - 2 Aleksey Miranchuk takes the corner kick and sends over a fantastic cross to the edge of the penalty area. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) jumps highest and plants a header into the goal. It's 0:2.
52' Corner kick. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) is ready to send the ball into the box.

52' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Giovanni Bonfanti (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lecce.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 0:1.
47' Roberto Piccoli sprays a pass out to Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
47' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) releases Gianluca Scamacca with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
46' Tullio Gritti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ederson comes on the pitch for Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
46' Half-time substitution. El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
44' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
44' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
39' That was close. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
37' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
34' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) wastes a huge opportunity from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the left post.
33' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Wladimiro Falcone.
29' Luca Gotti is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) suffers an injury and Lorenzo Venuti comes on.
29' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
27' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
27' What a chance that is! Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
25' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
24' Gianluca Scamacca releases Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
23' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

20' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the right side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Juan Musso.
19' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
18' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a save.
15' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Gianluca Scamacca.
13' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
10' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.

9' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
9' The ball is crossed into the box and Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Juan Musso gets a glove on it to thwart him.
7' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat.
6' Superb touch by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
5' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Antonio Rapuano signals.

4' Wladimiro Falcone makes a good save! Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
4' Atalanta hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is the one to supervise the game today.
